in_marathi.name: Ramila
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of love and beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ramila is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Rama, which means 'goddess of love', and Ila, which means 'beauty'. This name is often used to describe the divine feminine embodiment of love, beauty, and protection.
